sloka: रामदूतं च मां विद्धि सुग्रीवसचिवं कपिम् ।सो ऽहं दूत्येन रामस्य त्वत्सकाशमिहागतः ।। ५.५८.१३३ ।।।।
transliteration: rāmadūtaṁ ca māṁ viddhi sugrīvasacivaṁ kapim ।so 'haṁ dūtyena rāmasya tvatsakāśamihāgataḥ ।। 5.58.133 ।।।।

translations.english: 'I am a vanara, a messenger of Rama and minister of Sugriva.You may know that I have come here to convey the message of Rama to you.
